title: 第3章 众神的弟弟第4章 我一定会回来的
lines: 与此同时，在宙斯与克罗诺斯血战正酣之刻。
克洛诺斯腹中，那永恒的黑暗正被沸腾的神力乱流搅动。
“喂！哈迪斯！别光顾着自己那边！不是说好了要协同发力，轰击一个点吗？！”
波塞冬赤裸着肌肉贲张的上身，海蓝色的长发狂野地飞扬，他双拳交替轰击在一片不断剧烈蠕动，试图自我修复的胃壁上。
湛蓝的神力如怒涛般流转，顺着他拳锋灌入，在那坚韧无比的内壁上撕裂出裂痕。
不远处，黑暗仿佛有了生命，汇聚成一道道阴冷的尖锥，凿击在波塞冬轰出的裂痕边缘，将细微的伤口不断撕大。
哈迪斯的身影半隐在翻涌的黑雾中，只露出一张线条冷硬的侧脸。
“呵，管好你自己吧，蠢货。给吾看好你的拳头，别干扰了吾之侵蚀。”
他的声音低沉，带着一如既往的中二腔调，但出手的狠辣与精准，却与波塞冬形成了默契。
“死中二。”
波塞冬啐了一口，动作却丝毫未停，反而更加狂暴。他能感觉到，这层“墙壁”的防御正在某种内外夹击的态势下变得动摇。
“我说，那边的男人。能不能先闭嘴，把力气用在正地方？没看见我们姐妹几个已经快脱力了吗？”
赫拉的声音传来，带着明显的疲惫与不耐。
她悬浮在稍远的半空，赤红的长发无风自动，如同燃烧的火焰冠冕。
她双手结印，繁复的法阵在她身前明灭，将炽烈而纯净的破坏神力，转化为持续不断的冲击波，轰向目标区域。
因为持续高强度的神力输出，她光洁的额角渗出细密的汗珠，顺着精致的脸颊滑落，没入被汗水微微濡湿的衣襟。
暗红色的贴身长裙勾勒出惊心动魄的起伏曲线，随着她呼吸与施法的节奏微微颤动，散发出成熟女性的致命魅力。
在她身旁，德墨忒尔与赫斯提亚同样全力以赴。
德墨忒尔周身荡漾着淡金色的丰饶光辉，她将神力化作无数坚韧的根须与藤蔓，死死缠绕在片胃壁上，限制其自我修复，同时源源不断地将大地的脉动之力导入，从内部瓦解其结构。
她神情专注，淡褐色的长发有几缕黏在汗湿的颈侧，温婉的面容此刻充满了沉凝的力量感。
赫斯提亚则张开双臂，白金色的长发流淌着炉火般的温暖光晕。
她的神力不如其他人狂暴，却如同永恒不灭的圣火，温和而坚定地渗透着目标区域的“存在”本身，削弱其神性根基，并为其他三人提供着持续的治愈与状态加持。
她碧色的眼眸中满是担忧，但更多的是不容动摇的坚持。
“哈！赫拉，你这就不行了？看来你的体力还是比不过我啊。”
波塞冬在轰击间隙不忘回头嘴贱一句，汗水顺着他棱角分明的下颌滴落。
“你说什么！！”赫拉美目圆睁，手中法阵的光芒骤然暴涨，差点直接转向轰向波塞冬。
“行了，波塞冬。别再刺激她了，干活。”
赫斯提亚无奈地叹息，柔和的火光分出一缕，安抚般拂过赫拉，也顺便“烫”了一下波塞冬以示警告。
“哈迪斯你也是，注意保存神力。”德墨忒尔沉稳的声音如同大地般抚平躁动。
哈迪斯与赫拉对视一眼，终究没再说什么，重新将全副精神投入到眼前的“墙壁”上。
他们并非真的动怒，而是在这漫长的囚禁与并肩战斗中形成了独特的交流方式。
所有的私人恩怨，在“逃出去”与“复仇”这两个压倒一切的目标前，都可以暂时搁置。
内部的冲击与外界传来的力量里应外合，他们能感觉到，某种坚固的“枷锁”正在发出呻吟。
而在外界，奥林匹斯山巅的神王宫殿前，瑞亚听着那穿透神王躯体传出的沉闷撞击声，泪流满面。
“没错......是我的孩子们......他们从未放弃，他们在里面回应我们！”
墨提斯搀扶着因施展大型术法而虚弱的瑞亚，眼眸中闪烁着激动。
瑞亚抹去眼泪，看向克洛诺斯的眼神变得无比冰冷，那是被背叛的妻子与心疼子女的母亲交织出的刻骨恨意。
她强撑起身体，泰坦神后的力量在空中带起流光，一个复杂到可引动世界底层规则的法阵正在迅速成型。
“墨提斯，助我一臂之力！冲击时间节点！我们要将内部的通道彻底打开，让盖亚的药力与孩子们的力量产生共鸣！”
墨提斯毫不犹豫地将自己浩瀚的神力注入瑞亚的法阵中，红发飞扬，神情肃穆如献祭。
与此同时，正挥舞镰刀将宙斯逼入绝境的克洛诺斯，在听到腹中那越来越响的撞击声后，第一次露出了无法掩饰的慌乱。
content_en:
At the same time, the bloody battle between Zeus and Cronus was in full swing.
In the belly of Cronus, the eternal darkness was being stirred by the boiling turbulence of divine power.
"Hey! Hades! Don't just focus on your own side! Didn't we agree to coordinate our efforts to bombard a point?!"
Poseidon's muscular upper body was naked, and his long sea-blue hair was flying wildly. His fists alternately struck a stomach wall that was constantly squirming and trying to repair itself.
The azure divine power flowed like an angry wave, pouring along the edge of his fist, tearing cracks on the extremely tough inner wall.
Not far away, the darkness seemed to have come to life, converging into cold sharp cones that struck at the edges of the cracks blasted by Poseidon, tearing open the tiny wounds.
Hades' figure was half-hidden in the surging black mist, with only a profile of his face showing cold lines.
"Oh, take care of yourself, idiot. Watch your fists for me, don't interfere with my erosion."
His voice was low, with the same middle-class accent as always, but the ruthlessness and precision of his attacks formed a tacit understanding with Poseidon.
"Death in two."
Poseidon spat, but his movements did not stop at all, but became even more violent. He could feel that the defense of this "wall" was becoming shaken by some kind of internal and external attack.
"I said, man over there. Can you shut up and use your strength in the right place? Don't you see that our sisters are almost out of strength?"
Hera's voice came, with obvious fatigue and impatience.
She was suspended in mid-air a little further away, her long red hair moving without wind, like a crown of burning flames.
She formed seals with her hands, and the complex magic circle flickered in front of her, transforming the blazing and pure divine power of destruction into continuous shock waves, blasting towards the target area.
Due to the continuous high-intensity divine power output, fine beads of sweat oozed from her smooth forehead, sliding down her delicate cheeks and sinking into her clothes that were slightly damp with sweat.
The dark red long skirt outlines the thrilling undulating curves. It trembles slightly with the rhythm of her breathing and spell casting, exuding the fatal charm of a mature woman.
Beside her, Demeter and Hestia were equally giving their best.
Demeter's whole body was filled with pale golden fertility. She turned her divine power into countless tough roots and vines, which tightly wrapped around the stomach wall, restricting its self-repair. At the same time, she continuously introduced the pulsating power of the earth to disintegrate its structure from the inside.
She looked focused, a few strands of her long light brown hair stuck to the side of her sweaty neck, and her gentle face was filled with a sense of concentrated strength.
Hestia opened her arms, her long platinum hair flowing with a warm glow like a fire.
Her divine power is not as violent as others, but it is like an eternal holy fire, gently but firmly penetrating the "existence" itself in the target area, weakening its divine foundation, and providing continuous healing and status blessings for the other three.
Her green eyes were full of worry, but more importantly, they were filled with unshakable persistence.
"Ha! Hera, can't you do this? It seems that your physical strength is still no match for mine."
Poseidon didn't forget to turn around and say something mean between the bombardments, sweat dripping down his angular jaw.
"What did you say!!" Herami's eyes widened, and the light from the magic circle in her hand suddenly surged, almost turning directly towards Poseidon.
"Okay, Poseidon. Stop irritating her and get to work."
Hestia sighed helplessly, and a ray of soft firelight separated out, brushing against Hera like a comfort, and also "burned" Poseidon as a warning.
"Hades, you too, be careful to preserve your divine power." Demeter's steady voice was like the earth soothing the restlessness.
Hades and Hera looked at each other and said nothing. They focused their full attention on the "wall" in front of them again.
They were not really angry, but formed a unique way of communicating during this long period of imprisonment and fighting side by side.
All personal grudges can be put aside temporarily before the two overriding goals of "escape" and "revenge".
Boom, boom, boom, boom—! ! !
The internal impact was matched with the force coming from the outside, and they could feel that some kind of solid "shackles" were groaning.
...
In the outside world, in front of the God King's Palace on the top of Mount Olympus, Rhea burst into tears as she listened to the dull impact that penetrated the God King's body.
"Mother, this is..."
"That's right...it's my kids...they never give up, they respond to us on the inside!"
Metis supported Rhea, who was weakened by the large-scale spell, with excitement in his eyes.
Rhea wiped away her tears and looked at Cronus with extremely cold eyes. It was the deep hatred intertwined between the betrayed wife and the mother who loved her children.
She forced herself up, and the Titan Queen's power brought light in the air. A complex formation that could trigger the underlying rules of the world was rapidly taking shape.
"Metis, help me! Impact the time node! We must completely open the internal channel so that Gaia's medicine can resonate with the children's power!"
"Okay!"
Metis did not hesitate to inject his vast divine power into Rhea's magic circle, with his red hair flying and his expression as solemn as a sacrifice.
At the same time, Cronus, who was waving his scythe to corner Zeus, showed unconcealable panic for the first time after hearing the increasingly louder pounding in his belly.
title_en: Chapter 3 The Brother of the Gods Chapter 4 I will definitely come back
